Chinese: 地震報告: 根據地球物理氣象局初步分析，本地時間2026年10月25日19時25分55秒，於西藏那曲市巴青縣發生5.7級地震，震源深度約為10公里，震中約位於北緯32.43度，東經93.99度，距離澳門西北約2241公里。
Portuguese: Comunicado de sismo: A DSMG informa que no dia 25-10-2026 pelas 19:25:55 (hora local) foi registado um sismo de magnitude 5.7, profundidade 10 km, e cujo epicentro se localizou a cerca de 2241 km a noroeste de Macau, (32,43N, 93,99E), Tibete.
English: Earthquake Report: Initial analysis from Meteorological and Geophysical Bureau indicated that an earthquake of magnitude 5.7 , focal depth of 10 km, has occurred at 19:25:55 on 25 October 2026 (local time) in Xizang. The epicentre is located near 32.43N, 93.99E, about 2241 kilometres northwest of Macao.
